header.name: Pet Tools
header.description: v1.0.0 - Look at a tamed pet to see who owns it, and stop tamed dogs from hurting players.

settings.text: §lPet Tools§r - see who owns a pet, and keep tamed dogs off your friends.
§7Changes here take effect the next time the world loads.§r
Show a pet's owner when you look at it
settings.name: pet_tools:show_owner

settings.text: §7Look at a tamed dog, cat, parrot, horse or other tamed animal and the line above your hotbar names its owner.§r

§7A tamed dog joins any fight its owner is in, so one stray hit between friends sets the dog on them. With this on, a tamed dog's bite does no damage to any player. The dog may still chase and snap at them until it loses interest. Wild wolves are not affected.§r
